messages:
jess_product: FYI Meridian Biotech says they will not accept any invoice until a formal PO is processed in their Jaggaer portal and a vendor code is assigned. They also flagged a VAT/TIN name mismatch on their side — billing, can you take this?

mike_support: @anya_billing ping — this came in on PROD account meridian-prod. Customer attached PO and a screenshot of Jaggaer rejection. Link: https://files.redwood/repro/meridian_po.png

anya_billing: I'll take a look. Quick Q: do we have a W-9 or equivalent that matches the name on their PO? If Jaggaer requires a vendor code we probably need legal-name parity and tax docs.

sam_sales: We do have a signed SOW but we never completed vendor onboarding in their P2P system. I can initiate onboarding but need the exact legal entity name to register. Mike, paste the exact PO text you received.

mike_support: PO snippet from customer email:
```
Purchase Order: PO-2026-7849
Bill To: Meridian Biotech Inc.
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Total: $52,000
Invoice delivery: Jaggaer (e-invoice)
Notes: Include Vendor Code V-99321 or vendor will reject
```

anya_billing: Hmm — our vendor record lists them as "Meridian BioTech LLC" with a different TIN. That's the name/TIN mismatch. Jaggaer will reject inbound invoices until vendor record + tax ID match. We also need to submit a signed vendor form and possibly a W-8/W-9 depending on their jurisdiction.

jess_product: Can we generate a pro-forma invoice (non-payable) while vendor onboarding completes, or will procurement still refuse? Customer explicitly said they won't pay without PO/registration.

anya_billing: We can create a pro-forma for internal tracking, but they will not process payment without the PO and vendor code. Real action items: 1) collect signed W-9 (or equivalent) that matches PO name, 2) sales to create vendor registration in Jaggaer under the legal name on tax docs, 3) once vendor code assigned, submit invoice in UBL/XML format with PO number.

sam_sales: Reaching out to procurement contact (procurement@meridian-biotech.com) and cc'ing their AP lead laura.kim@meridian-biotech.com. I asked them to confirm whether the PO should read "Meridian BioTech LLC" instead, or if they can update their vendor profile.

vendorbot: Vendor registration workflow started — Ticket #VB-8842. Onboarding link: https://vendor.jaggaer.com/onboard/8842 — upload requested docs: signed W-9, certificate of incorporation, bank remit info.

mike_support: For repro: when we tried to push a test invoice to their Jaggaer endpoint it returns 403 + body "vendor not authorized / vendor code mismatch". Snapshot of header/log: `POST /invoices 403 {"error":"VENDOR_CODE_MISMATCH"}`.

anya_billing: Thanks — that matches expectation. Action plan summary I added to the billing queue:
- Collect correct legal-name + signed tax form from sales
- Sales submits vendor registration via Jaggaer link (include our bank remit details)
- Finance will wait for Vendor Code V-99321 assignment, then push invoice as UBL with PO-2026-7849 and cost center CC-571

jess_product: I'll update internal KB (support/billing/runbooks) with the Jaggaer repro steps and add a short checklist for sales to avoid TIN/name mismatches in future.

sam_sales: If finance wants a manual internal invoice to trigger our internal recognition, I can prepare one. Also requested procurement to issue a corrected PO if they can.

anya_billing: Will post back here when VB-8842 advances or when customer confirms corrected PO.

mike_support: Thanks all :thumbsup:
